title: MoonRey Productive Capacity to Access Bridge
notes: IMPLEMENTED at packages/access-economy/src/productive-access-bridge with productive-engine integration at packages/sunrey-economics/src/productive-access-bridge. Introduces AccessCapacityCommitment as a commitment of verified productive capacity to Access pools. Productive contribution evidence, MoonRey issuance, provider settlement, capacity commitment, and Access delivery remain distinct. Double-count protections enforce NO_PRODUCTIVE_CAPACITY_DOUBLE_COUNT, NO_ACCESS_USAGE_MINTS_MOONREY, NO_PROVIDER_SETTLEMENT_EQUALS_MOONREY_ISSUANCE, CAPACITY_COMMITMENT_LE_VERIFIED_AVAILABLE_CAPACITY, NO_OUTPUT_DELIVERY_DOUBLE_ISSUANCE, NO_PHANTOM_PRODUCTIVE_CAPACITY, NO_ORACLE_FACT_ALONE_MINTS, and ONLY_CANONICAL_MR_BALANCE_AFFECTS_MR_TWAB. Does not mint MoonRey from Access usage, define 1 productive unit = 1 MR, or create a second MoonRey engine. Simulation only.
